newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK market watchdog signs pacts with Brazil, Italy.
newsitem.headline: HK market watchdog signs pacts with Brazil, Italy.

text.p: Hong Kong's market watchdog, the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), said on Saturday it has signed co-operative agreements with its Italian and Brazilian counterparts.

The SFC said in a statement it signed on Friday a memorandum of understanding with Italy's Commissione Nazionale per le Societa e la Borsa and Brazil's Comissao de Valores Mobiliarios. The memorandums, both signed in South Africa's Cape Town, establish a framework for mutual assistance and facilitate the exchange of information, it said.
The SFC has entered into co-operative agreements with 26 securities and futures regulators around the world.
